How to get it

Nobody has found where it drops yet: no player has reported one, and no database lists a source for it. It is the epic half of the Partners in Crime set, whose other ring drops in the Deadmines.

What is known

  • The other ring of the set, the First Mate Band, drops from Mr. Smite in the Deadmines, from level 17.
  • This ring asks for level 60 and has item level 70, the level of raid gear: expect it from level 60 content.
  • Worn together, the two rings give +20 Strength and a chance on each swing to become Angry, +50 Strength for 10 seconds.

Not known yet

  • Which creature, quest or vendor gives it.

Checked on September 27, 2026: the Forever beta client (build 1.60.1.70009) holds the ring and its set but no loot table; the Forever database has no source for it either.
